--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem sModNat_eq_sMod (p k : ℕ) (hp : 2 ≤ p) : (sModNat (2 ^ p - 1) k : ℤ) = sMod p k := by
  have h1 := calc
    4 = 2 ^ 2 := by norm_num
    _ ≤ 2 ^ p := Nat.pow_le_pow_of_le_right (by norm_num) hp
  have h2 : 1 ≤ 2 ^ p := by omega
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    rw [sModNat, sMod, Int.ofNat_emod]
    simp [h2]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [sModNat, sMod, ← ih]
    have h3 : 2 ≤ 2 ^ p - 1 := by
      zify [h2]
      calc
        (2 : Int) ≤ 4 - 1 := by norm_num
        _         ≤ 2 ^ p - 1 := by zify at h1; exact Int.sub_le_sub_right h1 _
    zify [h2, h3]
    rw [← add_sub_assoc, sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_comm _ (-2), ← add_assoc,
      Int.add_emod_self, ← sub_eq_add_neg]

--src: Mathlib.Combinatorics.Colex
lemma geomSum_ofColex_strictMono (hn : 2 ≤ n) : StrictMono fun s ↦ ∑ k ∈ ofColex s, n ^ k := by
  rintro ⟨s⟩ ⟨t⟩ hst
  rw [toColex_lt_toColex_iff_exists_forall_lt] at hst
  obtain ⟨a, hat, has, ha⟩ := hst
  rw [← sum_sdiff_lt_sum_sdiff]
  exact (Nat.geomSum_lt hn <| by simpa).trans_le <| single_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ by positivity) <|
    mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hat, has⟩

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModEq
theorem add_mod_of_add_mod_lt {a b c : ℕ} (hc : a % c + b % c < c) :
    (a + b) % c = a % c + b % c := by rw [← add_mod_add_ite, if_neg (not_le_of_lt hc), add_zero]

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem ω_pow_eq_one (p' : ℕ) (h : lucasLehmerResidue (p' + 2) = 0) :
    (ω : X (q (p' + 2))) ^ 2 ^ (p' + 2) = 1 :=
  calc
    (ω : X (q (p' + 2))) ^ 2 ^ (p' + 2) = (ω ^ 2 ^ (p' + 1)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← pow_mul, ← Nat.pow_succ]
    _ = (-1) ^ 2 := by rw [ω_pow_eq_neg_one p' h]
    _ = 1 := by simp

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
lemma testTrueHelper (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.blt 1 p = true) (h : sModNatTR (2 ^ p - 1) (p - 2) = 0) :
    LucasLehmerTest p := by
  rw [Nat.blt_eq] at hp
  rw [LucasLehmerTest, LucasLehmer.residue_eq_zero_iff_sMod_eq_zero p hp, ← sModNat_eq_sMod p _ hp,
    ← sModNatTR_eq_sModNat, h]
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Totient
theorem totient_even {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 < n) : Even n.totient := by
  haveI : Fact (1 < n) := ⟨one_lt_two.trans hn⟩
  haveI : NeZero n := NeZero.of_gt hn
  suffices 2 = orderOf (-1 : (ZMod n)ˣ) by
    rw [← ZMod.card_units_eq_totient, even_iff_two_dvd, this]
    exact orderOf_dvd_card
  rw [← orderOf_units, Units.coe_neg_one, orderOf_neg_one, ringChar.eq (ZMod n) n, if_neg hn.ne']

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Defs
protected lemma pow_lt_pow_left (h : a < b) : ∀ {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → a ^ n < b ^ n
  | 1, _ => by simpa
  | n + 2, _ => Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le (Nat.pow_lt_pow_left h n.succ_ne_zero) (Nat.le_of_lt h)
    (zero_lt_of_lt h)

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.Fermat
lemma two_lt_fermatNumber (n : ℕ) : 2 < fermatNumber n := three_le_fermatNumber _

--src: Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Nat.Even
theorem one_lt_of_ne_zero_of_even (h0 : n ≠ 0) (hn : Even n) : 1 < n := by
  refine Nat.one_lt_iff_ne_zero_and_ne_one.mpr (And.intro h0 ?_)
  intro h
  rw [h] at hn
  exact Nat.not_even_one hn

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Prime.Basic
theorem Prime.eq_two_or_odd {p : ℕ} (hp : Prime p) : p = 2 ∨ p % 2 = 1 :=
  p.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one.imp_left fun h =>
    ((hp.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd 2 (dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h)).resolve_left (by decide)).symm

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem sZMod_eq_s (p' : ℕ) (i : ℕ) : sZMod (p' + 2) i = (s i : ZMod (2 ^ (p' + 2) - 1)) := by
  induction' i with i ih
  · dsimp [s, sZMod]
    norm_num
  · push_cast [s, sZMod, ih]; rfl
-- These next two don't make good `norm_cast` lemmas.

--src: Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.SModEq
theorem mul {I : Ideal A} {x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : A} (hxy₁ : x₁ ≡ y₁ [SMOD I])
    (hxy₂ : x₂ ≡ y₂ [SMOD I]) : x₁ * x₂ ≡ y₁ * y₂ [SMOD I] := by
  simp only [SModEq.def, Ideal.Quotient.mk_eq_mk, map_mul] at hxy₁ hxy₂ ⊢
  rw [hxy₁, hxy₂]

--src: Mathlib.Data.Holor
theorem cprankMax_add [Monoid α] [AddMonoid α] :
    ∀ {m : ℕ} {n : ℕ} {x : Holor α ds} {y : Holor α ds},
      CPRankMax m x → CPRankMax n y → CPRankMax (m + n) (x + y)
  | 0, n, x, y, hx, hy => by
    match hx with
    | CPRankMax.zero => simp only [zero_add, hy]
  | m + 1, n, _, y, CPRankMax.succ _ x₁ x₂ hx₁ hx₂, hy => by
    simp only [add_comm, add_assoc]
    apply CPRankMax.succ
    · assumption
    · -- Porting note: Single line is added.
      simp only [Nat.add_eq, add_zero, add_comm n m]
      exact cprankMax_add hx₂ hy

--src: Mathlib.SetTheory.Nimber.Basic
theorem lt_add_cases {a b c : Nimber} (h : a < b + c) : a + c < b ∨ a + b < c := by
  obtain ha | hb | hc := add_trichotomy <| add_assoc a b c ▸ add_ne_zero_iff.2 h.ne
  exacts [(h.asymm ha).elim, Or.inl <| add_comm c a ▸ hb, Or.inr hc]

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem sModNatTR_eq_sModNat (q : ℕ) (i : ℕ) : sModNatTR q i = sModNat q i := by
  rw [sModNatTR, helper, sModNat_aux_eq]
where
  helper b q k : sModNatTR.go q k b = sModNat_aux b q k := by
    induction k generalizing b with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [sModNatTR.go, ih, sModNat_aux]
      clear ih
      induction k with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ k ih =>
        rw [sModNat_aux, ih, sModNat_aux]
